the wire using wax. Then he heated the wire with a burner from the end where
the wire is clamped. Students observed the pin fall off.
A. If the teacher replaces aluminium wire by silver wire, will the students’
observation change? Justify your answer.
B. Will the aluminium wire melt? Give reason for your answer.
